title: Independent semantic verifier and calibration
scope: Dependency gate record for S2-006: every protected S2-005/policy input is pinned by Git blob id and SHA-256 over bytes read via `git show d7ce192:<path>` — never from the working tree or a self-generated narrative. The `resolved` section is written only by scripts/verify-s2-006-dependencies.mjs on a fully green verification and is deterministic (no wall clock, no pids).
rule: Any miss (missing object, wrong parent order, blob drift, digest drift, payload mismatch, executable drift, unpinned consumer input) exits non-zero as BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY before any measured semantic result may be published.

s2_005.title: Cross-domain retrieval and synthesis
s2_005.expectedParentsRule: Exactly these two parents, in Git order; the second parent is the exact S2-005 head. On task start refs/remotes/origin/main must point at the merge object; a later advance of origin/main requires a separate reviewed rebase binding (s2_005.rebaseBinding), which does not exist yet and therefore fails closed.

frozenS2_005InputsSha256.rule: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of `git show d7ce192:<path>`; each digest is additionally cross-checked against the independently frozen evidence/frozen-manifest.json — a mismatch between Git bytes and the frozen manifest fails the gate.

protectedPolicySha256.rule: SHA-256 over `git show d7ce192:<path>` of the policy surfaces S2-006 inherits. METRIC_POLICY, HUMAN_APPROVAL_POLICY and AUTONOMY_POLICY are stage-1 AgentOS artifacts; in this repository their executable surfaces are the contract policy engine, the human-decision contract, the capability matrix and the provider grant contract. The working-tree bytes must stay byte-identical to the pinned Git bytes.

mapping.contracts/grant.schema.json: AUTONOMY_POLICY surface (provider grant, S2-002 frozen upstream schema)

s1_011.title: Human decisions and authority binding
s1_011.relevanceToS2_006: Method-owner appointment and locked-test unseal are immutable HumanDecisions from an authenticated owner=user (spec §8); the authority-binding semantics come from verified S1-011 evidence, not narrative.

s1_012.title: Separation of confidence, calibration and support
s1_012.relevanceToS2_006: Expert lens, author confidence, measured calibration, evidence support and reviewer decision stay separate; no aggregate truth score (spec §10). Bound to verified S1-012 evidence.

stage1.recordBlobNote: recordBlob (Git blob id inside the pinned AgentOS repository) is null for S1-011/S1-012: the AgentOS object database is not reachable from this offline gate. The tracked copies are digest- and length-verified, and the payload fields are checked; the cross-repository blob id is resolved only in the full AgentOS checkout.

s2_006FrozenInputsSha256.rule: SHA-256 of the S2-006 frozen inputs as authored on this branch (executable consistency check): the working-tree bytes must match these digests. These files are not part of d7ce192 and are therefore not read from Git — they are pinned here and must never change after the first recorded result.

upstreamLimits.rule: All upstream limitations must be carried into S2-006, never silently dropped (spec §1.6).
carried: synthetic-only corpus: corpus/s2-006 is a fixture stratum; external-validity claims require externally authored, independently labelled cases
hashed TF-IDF instead of production embeddings (S2-005 vector baseline; no production semantic model)
global paired statistics NOT_MEASURED: the external locked_test global stratum is empty
novelty is only novel_to_selected_corpus against a named frozen corpus; world-novelty claims are refused
no production claim and no production authorization of any kind
semantic calibration is NOT_MEASURED / evaluator_not_independent until independent annotators and adjudicator exist

consumerInputs.rule: Every upstream input the S2-006 consumer depends on must be pinned by digest in s2_005.evidenceReadFromGitBytes, frozenS2_005InputsSha256, protectedPolicySha256 or s2_006FrozenInputsSha256 of this record; a consumer input that is not pinned fails the gate.

consequence: If every check passes, S2-006 verifier evidence may be recorded. Any missing file, unreachable commit, wrong parent order, digest drift, payload mismatch, executable drift or unpinned consumer input exits non-zero as BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY.
